svg.title: AI platform on Google Cloud: reference architecture
svg.text: Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform (formerly Vertex AI)
An AI platform on Google Cloud: what the platform team owns
Tenants come in through one front door. Everything below the line is shared, paved and paid for by the platform.
apps calling models over an API
1 Front door: one way in for every model call and tool call
2 Serving: managed first, self-hosted when you must
3 Build and release: notebooks to registry to endpoint, the same way every time
4 Data: governed once, used by every tenant
5 Landing zone: the guardrails nobody has to remember
Data Access on for AI APIs
Tenants never get a raw API key to a model or a GPU node. They get a project, a quota, a gateway route and a dashboard.
Layout: organization › folder ai-platform › one project per environment (dev, staging, prod) and per tenant. Product names as of November 2026.
